integrity: Proof uses explicit integral Mayer-Vietoris and Alexander duality; checker is finite corroboration over GF(2). Bibliographic novelty remains a best-knowledge assessment.
limitations: Balanced tripartite graphs, \(n\ge5\), and two clear paths only; no full homotopy type or other redundancy levels. Independent validation not performed.
title: Three-degree integral homology of two-path visibility complexes of balanced complete tripartite graphs
